# Completed maintainer-recorded nonempty reservoir round: 1 SQL observation, 384 hex cells.
# Follow-up to tools/kll/weighted_stream.answers.txt; findings: tools/kll/weighted_pending.md.
# Archived BigQuery bytes, not golden writer expectations. Do not regenerate.
# Permutation spelling does not contractually force aggregate execution order.
# Large input establishes unit 8; labelled weight-1 input supplies pending state.
# Distinguish direct upper-bit insertion from streaming the entire later weight.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(w, permutation, trial, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY w, permutation, trial)
FROM (
  SELECT w, permutation, trial,
         KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(item.v, 1000, weight => item.weight) AS s
  FROM UNNEST([8, 9, 15, 16, 17, 23, 24, 25]) AS w,
       UNNEST(['ABC', 'ACB', 'BAC', 'BCA', 'CAB', 'CBA']) AS permutation,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 7)) AS trial,
       UNNEST(SPLIT(permutation, '')) AS label,
       UNNEST([CASE label
         WHEN 'A' THEN STRUCT(42 AS v, 1048576 AS weight)
         WHEN 'B' THEN STRUCT(100 AS v, 1 AS weight)
         ELSE STRUCT(200 AS v, w AS weight)
       END]) AS item
  GROUP BY w, permutation, trial
)
